claim_legs.durability: Prospective sources, exact version-bound inputs, first-green plan/audit output and raw copies are tracked. audit.py --verify-saved rederives the saved result; recover.py --verify-saved authenticates saved bytes without original source reaccess. Book count disposition names the current watcher.
claim_legs.falsify: Altered domain/resolver controls reject omission, duplication, wrong owner/kind, invented primary, successful modeled return, stale numeric IDs, negative/boolean occurrences and unknown addresses. Order-only input permutations re-resolve the exact current path and owner. A separate book watcher rejects changed or redistributed planned counts.
claim_legs.rederive: Raw healthy opening/close events enumerate the selector plan; an independent source forest and original ownership oracle rederive every source, directory and lock owner, actual healthy closure and complete per-profile domain.

commit_gate: Staged doctrines and normal commit hooks must pass before commit.
limits: Prospective single-error selection only. No modeled close execution or simultaneous-failure coverage. Primary/grouped compositions, omissions, complete release applicability and native work remain separately owned.
scope: Pure saved-evidence selection and current-flow binding. No new fixture root, close control, original producer/main, native process or operating-system close ambiguity experiment.
task_integrity: Final compacted tree passes with every original node either live or exactly version-retrievable. The earlier task-compacted output belongs to the unchanged tree after the whole-subtree candidate was rejected before mutation.
